Initial release of 智能报销助手 (fb-expense-skill):

- Supports expense entry, invoice recognition, approval workflow, reimbursement status query, and expense analysis.
- Handles various expense types including transport, hotel, meals, communications, office supplies, and per diem.
- Automates invoice verification, duplicate checking, and policy compliance.
- Integrates with travel requests and supports role-based approval flow with history tracking.
- Provides statistics, trend analysis, and budget execution dashboards for individuals and departments.
- Includes comprehensive reporting, reminders, and interactive prompts for efficient reimbursement management.
